reports.title: Avista Corp. Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results, Confirms 2026 Utility Earnings Guidance

lines: Subject to market conditions, we expect to issue up to $15 million of additional common stock in 2026.
In 2027, we expect to issue up to $110 million of common stock.
In 2027, we expect to issue approximately $220 million of long-term debt.
Avista Corp. is confirming its 2026 non-GAAP utility earnings guidance with a range of $2.52 to $2.72 per diluted share.
The North Plains Connector project is not included and likely lies outside the 5-year planning horizon. * Projected rate base CAGR is calculated from forecast 2027 AMA rate base. 7.3% rate base CAGR*
